_readme: Fixture manifest. Adding a clip: run burnin.py over it, then
and add an entry here. The golden tests pick it up automatically.
`hand_labeled` is event truth read off the video BY A HUMAN (or a verified first pass),
frame by frame - filled 2026-08-26 from the step-04 labeling pass (full label files with
confidences + witnesses live in fixtures/labels/<stem>.events.json; definitions frozen in
address is omitted: the clip begins already settled (left-censored), so a +-3 criterion
cannot be applied to it. Do not fill these from the detector's own output; that would make
doc 08 Phase 0 wants >=10 fixtures spanning both views, both handedness, sim + range.
The golden manifest (groundtruth/goldenset.json) tracks that set; the two clips here are
the frozen hermetic inputs. Every acceptance percentage below N=10 is anecdote.

fixtures.notes: oblique/adult. Detector is weak here — contributes on 114/396 frames (29%). Address sits behind two decoy still-holds, which is what caught the D37 tempo bug.

DTL/junior. Detector strong — 298/341 frames (87%). Tempo legitimately reads 1.55:1; its Impact frame is independently confirmed by the club-head low point, so the D37 flag here is expected and is NOT a defect.
